RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's demographic composition alone is not evidence of bias. Academic hiring heavily weights qualitative factors beyond raw publication counts, including interview performance, job talks, departmental fit, teaching demonstrations, references, and specific strategic needs—such as the industry experience cited in the announcement.

Raising allegations of sex discrimination without concrete documentary or procedural evidence will almost certainly backfire, damaging your professional standing in a close-knit academic discipline. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about constructive feedback on your interview. Frame the request strictly around professional development and learning how to strengthen your candidacy for future academic appointments.
